item.title: Brepocitinib approved as first oral therapy for adult dermatomyositis
item.description: Brepocitinib has become the first oral therapy specifically approved for adults with dermatomyositis, offering a disease-specific alternative to existing treatments.

item.title: Deep learning model improves pediatric glioma recurrence prediction
item.description: Tak and colleagues developed a temporal deep-learning model to predict one-year pediatric glioma recurrence using surveillance magnetic resonance imaging.

item.title: New blood tests cannot yet replace food challenge
item.description: Component testing reduces false positives and cellular assays offer greater accuracy, but logistical issues prevent their routine use. Medscape Medical News.

item.title: Nurse-led digital therapeutics improves diabetes outcomes
item.description: A structured nurse-led digital therapeutics pathway is associated with higher adherence and better metabolic outcomes than usual care in adults with diabetes.
